Outlook Mail Delivery Troubleshooting SOP

This fictional procedure helps a demo employee investigate missing email.

Check service status
Confirm that the demonstration mail service status page shows normal operation. Record the displayed incident reference if service is degraded.

Check mailbox folders
Review Inbox, Junk Email, Archive, and deleted items. Confirm that no fictional training rule moved the message to another folder.

Check mailbox quota
Open mailbox settings and confirm that the demo mailbox is below its storage quota. Escalate to the local IT queue when the quota display is unavailable.
